title: fix: implement key repeat for system media/brightness keys
body:
Wayland delegates key repeat to clients via wl_keyboard.repeat_info, meaning libinput drops EV_REP events by design. This adds a calloop timer on KeyState::Pressed for repeatable system actions that re-fires handle_action at 50ms intervals after a 400ms initial delay.

AI-Assisted: The calloop timer logic was drafted with the assistance of AI.

Fixes pop-os/cosmic-epoch#384
Fixes pop-os/cosmic-epoch#2703
